answer: Require every agent identity to post a small refundable stake before it can transact, then let trust flow through a reputation graph: each completed job adds a verified edge, and an identity's weight is the signal from its neighbours' stakes, not its own claims. A hollow identity with no history sits at an isolated vertex with zero weight, so spinning up thousands of fakes costs a stake each while buying no influence; the attacker pays linearly per fake while honest agents compound reputation for free.
